name: Badam Milk
description: Creamy badam milk made with almonds, milk and cardamom, with optional saffron and pistachio for a fragrant warm or chilled drink.
method: Blend the soaked, peeled almonds with a small amount of the milk until as smooth as your blender allows.
Warm the remaining milk gently in a saucepan, stirring occasionally so it does not catch on the base.
Add the almond paste, sugar and cardamom and stir thoroughly to disperse the almond mixture.
Simmer gently for several minutes, stirring regularly, until the drink is fragrant and slightly richer in texture. Add saffron during this stage if using.
Taste and adjust sweetness, then pour into cups for a warm drink or cool promptly and refrigerate if you prefer it chilled.
Garnish with chopped pistachios just before serving.
